Welcome

A small hotel with a big sense of calm

Marnel is a boutique hotel of just eight rooms. Warm timber, natural light and layers of tropical greenery shape every space, from the guest rooms to the courtyard pool and the open restaurant.

Small by design, so every stay feels personal and unhurried.

Around us

Discover Weligama

Weligama means “sandy village”. It sits on a wide southern bay known for beginner surf and a long tradition of lace-making, with the south coast’s best-known sights close by.

On the doorstep

Weligama Bay

A sandy bay about 3 km long, known as one of the best beginner-friendly surf breaks in the world. Take a lesson, join a surf camp or watch the sunset.

Short drive

Midigama & Kabalana

Neighbouring beaches along the same stretch of coast, popular with surfers and beach-goers.

Short drive

Mirissa & whale watching

A famous south-coast beach and a starting point for whale-watching cruises. The season is generally November to April.

In town

Kushtarajagala

An ancient stone statue and one of Weligama’s best-known landmarks.

Local craft

Weligama lace

The town has been known for bobbin lace-making since the 16th century.

In the bay

Taprobane Island

A tiny island just off the beach with a private villa. Best admired from the sand, especially at sunset.

Day trip · about 24 km

Galle Fort

A UNESCO World Heritage Site, built by the Portuguese in 1588 and fortified by the Dutch in 1649. Walk the ramparts at sunset.

Day trip

Dondra Head Lighthouse

At the southernmost tip of Sri Lanka, near Matara, one of the island’s best-known lighthouses.

Day trip

Tea estate visit

Handunugoda Tea Estate, a short journey from Weligama, offers a chance to see how Ceylon tea is made.

Distances and seasons are approximate. We are happy to help arrange surf lessons, tours and transfers.
